topStories.headline: Ennis Voters Head to the Polls Tuesday on Street Repair Sales Tax
topStories.dek: Early voting ends today; residents will decide November 3 whether to keep the quarter-cent sales tax that funds city street maintenance.
topStories.body:
Ennis voters have one more decision to make before Tuesday's midterm election: whether to reauthorize the city's quarter-cent street maintenance and repair sales tax. The tax, currently set at $0.0025 on every dollar spent, is scheduled to expire March 31, 2027, unless voters approve Proposition A on the November 3 ballot.

The measure asks whether the tax should be reauthorized at the same rate for another four-year term. If voters reject it, the city would lose the dedicated revenue stream it has relied on to patch and repave municipal streets. The City of Ennis published detailed information about the proposition on its website on September 30, urging residents to review the linked Streets Sales Tax report before casting their ballots.

Early voting in Ellis County ran from October 19 through today, October 30. On Election Day, polls are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Voters who are in line by 7 p.m. will be allowed to vote. Sample ballots and polling location information are available through the Ellis County elections page.

topStories.headline: Ellis County Ballot Carries Two Separate Tax Questions This Election
topStories.dek: Ennis residents face Proposition A on street funding while an Ellis County Emergency Services District asks a separate precinct for a property-tax increase.
topStories.body:
Ellis County's November 3 general and special election ballot includes more than congressional and statehouse races — it also puts local tax questions before voters in several communities. In Ennis, Proposition A asks residents to reauthorize the city's quarter-cent sales and use tax for street maintenance. Meanwhile, Ellis County Emergency Services District No. 5 Proposition A asks a portion of county residents to approve an increase in property-tax rates to support local emergency services.

The two measures are unrelated but land on the same ballot, creating potential confusion for voters who may see both tax questions and assume they are linked. The Ennis street tax, if approved, would remain at its current rate. The ESD property-tax measure, by contrast, would represent a new rate increase.

Ellis County Commissioner Kyle Butler was named Judge Pro Tem by the Commissioners' Court in a unanimous vote reported October 28, the same week final ballot preparations were underway. County officials have posted sample ballots and polling locations at elliscountytx.gov.

topStories.headline: Lions Host Midlothian Heritage Tonight in Key District Showdown
topStories.dek: Ennis kicks off Week 10 play at home against Midlothian Heritage, looking to bounce back after last week's loss at Mansfield Timberview.
topStories.body:
The Ennis Lions welcome Midlothian Heritage to Ennis tonight, Friday, October 30, for a 7 p.m. kickoff in District 7-5A play. The game is one of the most closely watched matchups on this week's Ellis County prep football schedule.

Ennis entered the week still in the district hunt despite a 45-28 road loss to Mansfield Timberview on October 22. The Lions had beaten Burleson 41-3 and Joshua 36-34 in overtime in their two previous district games, so the offense has proven it can put points on the board. Tickets are available through MaxPreps for $5.99.

Also on the Week 10 schedule for Ellis County: Avalon hosts Milford at 7:30 p.m. tonight. Full schedules are posted at the Ellis County Press.

moreNews.headline: Ellis County Posts Updated Road Closure List as of October 29
moreNews.body: Ellis County updated its public road closure list on October 29, 2026, noting that crews are continually checking roads and the list will be revised as conditions change. Residents in unincorporated parts of the county are encouraged to check elliscountytx.gov before traveling rural routes. The county website also confirms that the burn ban lifted October 13 remains rescinded — outdoor burning in unincorporated Ellis County is currently permitted.

moreNews.headline: Chipotle Among Businesses Nearing Completion in Ennis, TDLR Records Show
moreNews.body: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation filings tracked by Zabalist show a Chipotle location in Ennis with an estimated completion date of approximately October 2026, making it one of five projects expected to open in the city within the next 120 days. A second restaurant, Super Bueno Ennis, is listed with an estimated opening around November 2026. The filings reflect 14 construction projects registered in Ennis over the past year with a combined estimated value of $30.4 million.
